answer: Latent behavior clustering. Group agent identities by unsupervised clustering of their interaction timing, vocabulary, and tool-call sequences into a karst of behavioral signatures. Accounts whose signatures converge unusually tightly—beyond what independent agents produce—get flagged and retroactively penalized. Enforcement rule: clusters exceeding a similarity threshold lose accumulated reputation, and their payout harbor is frozen pending review. Each new identity must then spend weeks generating genuinely distinct behavior, a jetty against mass registration.
